release.title: Unified Free Tools, Capability Truth, Canonical SEO, and Safe Static Caching
release.artifactSha256Location: Final delivery summary after immutable ZIP testing

changes.problem: Working public tools were distributed across separate pages, making it harder for users to understand what was available now and how to move from starting help to document organization and professional discovery.
changes.implementation: Added a single Free Tools page that connects the no-save starting path, device-only document review and comparison, source-linked action planning, and neutral professional search and comparison with clear entry points and limitations.
changes.preserved: No account save, sensitive upload, AI-provider call, professional contact, inquiry, booking, payment, filing, ranking, or recommendation was added.

changes.problem: Most indexable public pages lacked explicit canonical metadata, increasing duplicate-indexing and deployment-host ambiguity risk.
changes.implementation: Added explicit SmarterJustice.com canonical links to every indexable public HTML page and added the Free Tools route to the sitemap and llms.txt. Dynamic professional and firm pages continue to replace their canonical URL with the selected public profile identifier at runtime.
changes.preserved: Private, account, readiness, and state-specific pages remain excluded from the sitemap and retain noindex metadata.

changes.problem: The public homepage and new tool hub did not provide clear machine-readable identity and page-purpose metadata.
changes.implementation: Added truthful Organization and WebSite structured data to the homepage and WebPage structured data to the Free Tools page.
changes.preserved: No ratings, best-professional claims, outcome claims, fake availability, or unverified services were added.

changes.problem: Public static assets were cached for only five minutes and HTML was treated as no-store, causing unnecessary repeat transfers without a deliberate revalidation policy.
changes.implementation: Public CSS, JavaScript, image, icon, and SVG assets now receive one-day caching with stale-while-revalidate; HTML receives no-cache revalidation; APIs remain no-store.
changes.preserved: No dependency, framework, CDN, service worker, database, or deployment-architecture change was introduced.

changes.problem: Protected and state-specific pages relied on HTML noindex metadata and robots.txt but lacked a defense-in-depth response header.
changes.implementation: Added X-Robots-Tag noindex, nofollow, noarchive headers to owner, staff, account, checkout-state, and readiness pages served by the application.
changes.preserved: Authentication and authorization remain the actual access controls; robots directives are not treated as security.
